status: Accepted by the author on 2026-10-04; all static/native and author checks passed.

static.canonical_text: Shared Minor fixed bonuses; current Trucazo/activation rules only. No new powers or balance values.

native.development_dependency: Doom II IWAD and locally discovered id24res.wad used for development only; engine, WADs, fixtures and saves are not distributed.
native.scope: All listed runs used the final package hash below except release_rollback, which used the accepted 4.37.17 package.
functional_coverage: Idempotent transient browser; empty/learned/filter lists and browsing without a station.
Actual owned IDs, duplicate Pickaxes with different wear, Box accessibility and nearby-item exclusion.
Equipped, temporary, tutorial-first-weapon, full-durability, recipe, station and material blocking reasons.
Stale identity/removal and repeated confirmation cannot act on a different copy.
Recovery preview matches native quantities/time and cannot change an active task output reservation.
Native repair/dismantle completion affects only the exact item; refreshed lists reflect removal and repair.
All 56 Minors preserve +3 per attribute; campaign active bonuses, concealed unknown powers and Fool exclusion.
Learned recipe refresh, task start and world power activation at three resolutions.
Save load/reload preserves IDs, wear, recipes, paused repair reservations, essence selection, active effects and cooldowns.
Saved repair resumes at a native workbench and completes the same sword without changing the other Pickaxe.
A save written with the new Journal open loads on the accepted old package.
Y opens time skip; native confirmation completes the exact dismantling target and refreshes its list.

commands.visual: Separate fresh configurations; native screenshot commands exercise Craft, Repair, Dismantle, task state, active Tarot, long effects, concealed art preview and unimplemented owned Major. Fixtures initialize data and call existing native operations.

native.log_normalization: Installation paths replaced with role placeholders; trailing whitespace and line endings normalized. No test/error lines removed.

desktop_interaction.method: Computer Use / @oai/sky, observed window and refreshed screenshot after each action.
passed: Click Repair, select Pickaxe #2 by row and observe its own wear/requirements.
Use 3, Right and Enter to start dismantling the selected copy.
Use Y to open the existing time panel; return from native completion to a refreshed five-weapon list.
Click all seven main Journal icons and reach the corresponding pages.

The existing C moon cursor follows the new hit areas.

desktop_interaction.physical_controller: Not tested by the agent; the author accepted the conditional controller check on 2026-10-04, without identifying hardware.

save_compatibility.rollback_result: Seven state assertions passed with the migrated final save on 4.37.17; no map geometry changes.

resolved_diagnostics.resolution: Use operation parameter; all three native flow modes pass.

resolved_diagnostics.finding: Default VirtualToRealCoords aspect handling displaced outer tab hit areas in widescreen.
resolved_diagnostics.resolution: Use the same 640x360 draw projection with vbottom/handleaspect false; desktop clicks pass.

resolved_diagnostics.finding: Native IsUiProcessor/RequireMouse flags on the saved Journal handler would persist into rollback.
resolved_diagnostics.resolution: An unsaved static adapter owns the flags; final save JSON and old-package load verified.

resolved_diagnostics.finding: Early local QA fixtures used a wrong recipe/ownership removal/material efficiency setup and one nonexistent diagnostic helper.
resolved_diagnostics.resolution: Corrected unshipped fixtures; final source and all retained logs compile without these diagnostics.

observations_outside_scope: The unchanged Reputation page has footer overlap at 1024x768. This patch only adds main-tab mouse navigation there; its layout is outside Craft/Tarot scope.
